wiki.content: "The place where it rained" is a very moody song in DELTARUNE. It was a song made to reference the original track it samples, "It's Raining Somewhere Else" from UNDERTALE, DELTARUNE's parallel universe, which plays during the "date" with Sans in the CORE Hotel. The titles of the tracks strengthen this connection, implying that Hometown (or Deltarune's world in general) may be the "somewhere else" previously alluded to. The most notable difference between the two tracks is the usage of Sans's leitmotif, as The place where it rained removes any references to said leitmotif while retaining the remainder of the song's melody.
